record.question: The amount of money given by RBI to the Central government- its highest transfer ever-sparking a fierce debate in India is
record.explanation: Answer A: 1.76 Lakh crores. The widely reported 2019 RBI surplus and excess-provision transfer was ₹1,76,051 crore, approximately ₹1.76 lakh crore. Reference: https://indianexpress.com/article/business/banking-and-finance/rbi-approves-surplus-transfer-of-rs-1-76-lakh-crore-to-govt-5939102/. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
